name: Wan2.1
notes: Use --offload_model True and --t5_cpu when memory is tight on single-GPU hosts.
The same codebase covers both the T2V and I2V checkpoints.

sample_scripts.title: Wan2.1 T2V 14B smoke test
commands: python generate.py --task t2v-14B --size 1280*720 --ckpt_dir "$WEIGHTS_ROOT/wan2.1/Wan2.1-T2V-14B" --offload_model True --prompt "${PROMPT:-Two anthropomorphic cats in comfy boxing gear and bright gloves fight intensely on a spotlighted stage.}" --save_file "$OUTPUT_ROOT/wan2.1/wan2.1-t2v-14b.mp4"

sample_scripts.title: Wan2.1 I2V 14B 720P smoke test
commands: python generate.py --task i2v-14B --size 1280*720 --ckpt_dir "$WEIGHTS_ROOT/wan2.1/Wan2.1-I2V-14B-720P" --image "$INPUT_IMAGE" --offload_model True --prompt "${PROMPT:-Summer beach vacation style, a white cat wearing sunglasses sits on a surfboard.}" --save_file "$OUTPUT_ROOT/wan2.1/wan2.1-i2v-14b-720p.mp4"

name: HunyuanVideo-1.5
notes: Official source-code inference supports both T2V and I2V through generate.py.
Use --rewrite false if you do not have a vLLM-compatible prompt rewrite service.
For the 480p step-distilled I2V checkpoint, the upstream README recommends 8 or 12 steps.

sample_scripts.title: HunyuanVideo-1.5 480P I2V step-distilled smoke test
commands: torchrun --nproc_per_node="${NPROC_PER_NODE:-1}" generate.py --prompt "${PROMPT:-Summer beach vacation style, a white cat wearing sunglasses sits on a surfboard.}" --image_path "$INPUT_IMAGE" --resolution 480p --aspect_ratio 16:9 --seed "${SEED:-1}" --rewrite false --cfg_distilled true --enable_step_distill true --use_sageattn false --sparse_attn false --enable_cache true --cache_type deepcache --overlap_group_offloading false --sr false --output_path "$OUTPUT_ROOT/hunyuanvideo-1.5/hunyuanvideo-1.5-i2v.mp4" --model_path "$WEIGHTS_ROOT/hunyuanvideo-1.5"

name: Open-Sora v2
notes: The current repo tree uses configs under configs/diffusion/inference/, for example 256px.py.
Those configs expect repo-relative checkpoint files under ./ckpts, including Open_Sora_v2.safetensors, hunyuan_vae.safetensors, T5, CLIP, and flux plugin weights.
This is the heaviest setup in the shortlist, so it stays as a research baseline rather than a first smoke test.
download_steps: echo "Copy or symlink the required checkpoint files into $CODE_ROOT/Open-Sora/ckpts to match configs/diffusion/inference/*.py"

name: Mochi 1
notes: The official repo uses uv already, so this is the cleanest upstream environment to reproduce on DPLab.
Install ffmpeg before trying to export videos from the CLI or Gradio UI.
CPU offload is only supported in single-GPU mode.

sample_scripts.title: Mochi 1 CLI smoke test
commands: python3 ./demos/cli.py --model_dir "$WEIGHTS_ROOT/mochi-1-preview" --cpu_offload --prompt "${PROMPT:-A cinematic close-up of a lemon tart on a wooden table, shot with soft natural light.}" --seed "${SEED:-12345}" --out_dir "$OUTPUT_ROOT/mochi-1"

name: CogVideoX1.5
install_steps: pip install --upgrade transformers accelerate diffusers imageio-ffmpeg
notes: The model card recommends BF16 and lists 9 GB minimum GPU memory for single-GPU inference.
The published model card is English-only.
For first-pass MMVGM integration, treat this as a low-friction fallback rather than the primary benchmark family.
